disclaimer: Producer-only discovery list. Not rankings, not Rookie Alpha inputs, not runtime-visible, not draft predictions. Inclusion means only that CFBD roster data placed the player at a tracked position with draft-eligible academic standing (or a sophomore breakout). Promotion to the real seed pool is an operator decision.
observation_method: Season-to-date CFBD /stats/player/season. Shares divide player totals by the sum of all CFBD player rows for the same team and category. target_share and targets are null because CFBD season stats carry no targets stat. Missing stat rows are null, never zero.
eligibility_rule: academic_year >= 3, or academic_year == 2 with breakout_flagged == true
academic_year_rule: current CFBD roster year when the team roster is populated; else prior-season CFBD year + 1 (capped at 5) by CFBD player id; else skipped
